rationale_one_line: ECC's own site read low-confidence on extraction, but the story is literally 'Everything Claude Code' -- the cream-and-terracotta Claude preset is the earned, on-theme fallback, not a random pick.
writing_tone_notes: Technical and direct, build-in-public. Let the numbers carry the praise: hackathon win, viral thread, star count. No hype adjectives.
do_rules: Lead with the origin story (hackathon -> viral thread -> open source) as the differentiator, growth number as the hook
Show the cross-tool reach (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) as a diagram or ticked list, not a claim
Count up the star number over the sparkline draw
dont_rules: Don't say '225k stars' in both the tweet and a scene card
Don't editorialize about the 'dividing the developer community' angle -- stay admiring, not comparative
